messages:
mira: Quick sync — planning a compact LaunchWire webinar + credit surge experiment. Goal: boost first-week DAUs by nudging webinar registrants into the prompt-template onboarding flow. cc @jamal @lucy

jamal: Love it. What's the primary hypothesis? More seats + small credits -> higher prompt-template adoption?

mira: Yep. Hypothesis A: 30 free credits for registrants who attend -> 25% convert to active prompt-template use within 7 days. Hypothesis B: adding a triggered onboarding nudge (email + in-app) lifts conversion another 10%.

lucy: Seats: we can open 500 seats. Recommend 2 CTAs on the landing page: 1) RSVP (gets reminder + 10 credits), 2) Attend (gets 30 credits + prompt pack). We should A/B the CTA wording.

kevin: Routing note — inbound registrants should be bucketed into cohorts by intent signal (dev vs product) so we send appropriate prompt packs. Quick config I sketched:```yaml
experiment: launchwire-credit-surge
cohorts:
  - id: dev
    credit: 30
    prompt_pack: dev_starter
  - id: product
    credit: 30
    prompt_pack: product_templates
control_credit: 10
tracking: utm_campaign=launchwire
```

mira: Love that. Lucy, can you own the landing CTA copy A/B? Jamal — own cohort tagging + event tracking? Kevin — coordinate with eng to ensure credits are delivered and KV cache for prompt packs is warmed.

lucy: Yep, will do. Draft copy options in the doc: https://notion.so/redwood/launchwire-copy (please comment).

jamal: On it. I'll add the tracking spec and an event map. Quick ask — do we gate credits until they complete the onboarding flow or give them up front?

mira: Give 10 up front on RSVP to reduce friction. Give remaining 20 on attendance + completion of a 3-step prompt onboarding (open template + run sample + save). That helps measure engagement.

kevin: Backend note: implement credit award as two events: `credit_awarded_reservation` and `credit_awarded_attendance`. Use idempotency token. I can prototype webhook + lambda to mint credits.

marketing-bot: registration-count: 42 registrants (first 2 hours) — auto-update every 30m. :rocket:

lucy: Also propose a small benchmark narrative for post-mortem: baseline conversion, timing to first prompt, average tokens used in first 3 sessions. We want to show unit economics per activated user.

mira: Exactly. Add these metrics to the analytics dashboard. Jamal, please define event KPIs: signups -> attended -> prompt-open -> prompt-run -> saved-template -> paid-conversion (30d).

jamal: Will draft KPIs today and sync with analytics. Also tagging marketing attribution with first_touch and last_touch utms.

mira: Ok next steps and owners:
- lucy: CTA copy A/B + landing update by Tue EOD
- jamal: cohort tagging + KPI spec + analytics events by Wed
- kevin: credits webhook prototype + infra checklist by Wed
- mira: webinar script + prompt-pack outline by Thu

mira: Quick check-in Friday for final roll call. Any blockers?

kevin: small one — need 1 GPU instance for warming prompt-pack caches before show. I can request it tomorrow.

lucy: no blockers from my side.

jamal: none yet. starting spec now.

mira: Awesome — thanks team. I'll post a short timeline + Notion link after this thread. :sparkles:
